results.title: How to Talk Australians: The Movie
results.original_title: How to Talk Australians: The Movie
results.overview: A group of students and teachers from The Delhi College of Linguistics hit the road to discover Australia and gain first-hand experience of its authentic language and culture. When their plane is diverted to the country town of Dubbo due to storms, and their tour-leader is detained by customs, the hapless bunch unearth the 'real' Australia while never making it to Sydney, Melbourne...or even Brisbane.

results.title: Baby Majeur
results.overview: Umi, a singer-songwriter, has just become a mother. In her urban flat, she tries to get the hang of life as a mum. But this is disrupted by chaos: noise from her upstairs neighbour, hustle and bustle, and unsolicited advice. Amid pumping, nappies and other people's expectations, Umi briefly loses herself. Slowly, she seeks the space to reconnect with her own feelings. With her ukulele, she begins turning her emotions into music and finds her own voice again.

results.title: Clay
results.overview: Clay Mashon is a 6-year-old boy with two loving parents about to start his first year of school.  The only issue is, Clay is made entirely of blue plasticine.

results.title: The Last Flight
results.overview: A high-stakes romantic entanglement develops within a commercial airline company when a prominent pilot enters into a clandestine relationship with a flight attendant from his past, triggering a volatile cycle of psychological warfare with his ambitious, influencer partner.

results.title: Peter Asher: Everywhere Man
results.overview: Peter Asher’s extraordinary life has intersected with some of the greatest artists and musical moments of the last six decades. A child actor who became a pop star and then a manager and producer to the likes of James Taylor and Linda Ronstadt, he is a Zelig-like figure who remains a vital creative force to this day. Featuring interviews with Paul McCartney, Carole King, and many more.

results.title: The End
results.overview: A stop-motion doomsday comedy, in which airport-bound creatures wait out the impending apocalypse.

results.title: King of My Love
results.overview: The noble and beloved policeman Ramash, thanks to whom peace and order reign in the city of Khurmada, joins the fight against the cunning, greedy bandit Shamar. Shamar, raised by foster parents, arranges a series of crimes in the city, and Ramash stands up for Khurmada. During the active confrontation, it turns out that Ramash and Shamar are brothers separated in childhood. The brothers' investigation leads them to the trail of the culprit of the great fire that claimed the lives of Ramash and Shamar's parents. They turn out to be Khurmada's main patron and patron, Sandurlai, with whom they have to fight.

results.title: Adhey Neevu Adhey Nenu
results.overview: Sagar, a software engineer, and his wife Sri Valli live in a gated community in Hyderabad. As work consumes Sagar, a lonely Sri Valli is drawn to Karthik, a charming new neighbour in town on a project from Canada, until shocking truths about her husband surface and a crime turns all three lives upside down.

results.title: Furies
results.overview: During Lebanon's corruption-fueled economic collapse, the banks freeze millions of depositors out of their own life savings. Maro, a determined single mom, and her wild-hearted sister Dalia begin to scheme a daring, all-night heist to get their own money back.

results.title: Vampire Zombies...from Space!
results.overview: From the depths of space, Dracula has devised his most dastardly plan yet; turning the residents of the small town of Marlow into his personal army of vampire zombies! A motley crew consisting of a grizzled detective, a rookie cop, a chain-smoking greaser, and a determined young woman band together to save the world from — (see title).

results.title: SUMO: Spirit Weighs Nothing
results.overview: SUMO: Spirit Weighs Nothing grants rare inside access to Japan’s notoriously private world of sumo. Over a turbulent year of sacrifice and survival, wrestlers at different stages of their career fight to endure within one of Japan’s most punishing traditions. Behind the curtain, true strength is measured — not in flesh, but in refining the spirit.

results.title: The Boy by the Pool
results.overview: A woman's sun-soaked vacation takes a sinister turn when she meets a picture-perfect couple whose son bears a striking resemblance to a young boy who disappeared two years earlier.

results.title: AAA Verano de Escándalo 2026 - Week 2
results.overview: Week 2 of AAA Verano de Escándalo from Aguascalientes features a AAA World Cruiserweight Championship match as Rey Fenix clashes against Mini Vikingo. Plus, La Parka, Mecha Wolf, and Lince Dorado battle for a spot at Triplemanía and the opportunity to challenge for the AAA Latin American Championship. Also, Galeno teams up with Hijo de Dr. Wagner Jr. to take on Drago and Dinámico.

results.title: The Disenchantment
results.overview: In a remote village in the Pyrenees, Inés discovers that the relocation of an ancient church is only the beginning of an immersion into a magical and ancestral world that will change her perception of life and death.

results.title: In Tania's Head
results.overview: Tania Head became a household name as a 9/11 survivor, celebrated for her miraculous escape from the very floor the plane hit. Her story of resilience, coupled with the heartbreaking death of her fiancé, Dave, moved the nation. As president of the Survivors' Network, she was a symbol of American strength, a fixture alongside political elites at Ground Zero. The illusion shattered in 2007 when a New York Times investigation proved her story was a lie: her career, her fiancé, even her identity.

results.title: Maddie's Secret
results.overview: A plucky dishwasher leaps to viral superstardom at a trendy food content creation company. While her life seems picturesque — complete with an adoring husband, ride-or-die best friend and a cupboard full of woman-owned ethically-sourced chili crisp to boot — mounting professional pressures threaten to reawaken a hidden secret from her troubled past.

results.title: Janine Harouni: Man'oushe
results.overview: Janine Harouni’s second stand up special filmed at London’s Theatre Royal Stratford East

results.title: Real Madrid: The Weight of Greatness
results.original_title: Real Madrid: The Weight of Greatness
results.overview: Experience an unprecedented, all-access look inside a Real Madrid Champions League match day, revealing up close what it takes to live up to the legacy of the world’s most successful football club.

results.title: What a Way To Go
results.overview: Five old friends. One last voyage. Fed up with being written off — dismissed by their children, care homes looming, invisible to the world - they decide to defy expectations and take a sailing boat for one last adventure. No itinerary, no carers. Just open waters, old bonds and a bumbag or recreational drugs. Determined to prove that life, at any stage, is what you make of it.
